meta.source: Home Cloud Dashboard canvas (108 screens), hand-extracted

tokens.name: wall-base
tokens.usage: Wallpaper base colour, behind the three glows. Also the page background when no wallpaper is drawn.

tokens.name: wall-coral
tokens.usage: Dusk wallpaper glow, top-left. Wallpaper only, never UI.

tokens.name: wall-violet
tokens.usage: Dusk wallpaper glow, top-right. Wallpaper only, never UI.

tokens.name: wall-teal
tokens.usage: Dusk wallpaper glow, bottom. Wallpaper only, never UI.

tokens.name: logo-coral
tokens.usage: Logo gradient start (bottom of the h stem) and first dot. Logo only.

tokens.name: logo-violet
tokens.usage: Logo gradient middle. The middle dot uses accent. Logo only.

tokens.name: logo-teal
tokens.usage: Logo gradient end (right of the cloud) and third dot. Logo only.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the wallpaper behind windows (Store, Settings, Files). Dialog scrims use scrim-strong.

tokens.name: scrim-strong
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and sheets; everything under it is inert.

tokens.name: surface-widget
tokens.usage: Home widgets, search pill, notification bell. Glass level 1: sits directly on the wallpaper.

tokens.name: surface-window
tokens.usage: Large windows: App Store, Settings, Files, Live usage, app window. Glass level 2.

tokens.name: surface-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, menus and toasts. Glass level 3: nearly opaque so text stays readable over anything.

tokens.name: surface-row
tokens.usage: Grouped list boxes, cards inside windows, info tiles.

tokens.name: surface-control
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, chips, inactive tab items, icon buttons.

tokens.name: surface-input
tokens.usage: Text field fill.

tokens.name: border-glass
tokens.usage: 1px edge on every glass surface; gives it a lit rim.

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: Text field and select outline at rest.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows inside a list box.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface in this system.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: row subtitles, descriptions, widget labels.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, keyboard hints, placeholders. 12px and up only.

tokens.name: ink-on-light
tokens.usage: Text and icons on fill-primary (white buttons, selected segment).

tokens.name: fill-primary
tokens.usage: The one primary action per view: white pill with ink-on-light text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Progress fills, selected borders, radio dots, focus ring. Tweakable per user (Mint #5eead4, Amber #fbbf24, Rose #f9a8d4).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Switch track when on; checkbox and radio accent-color.

tokens.name: accent-link
tokens.usage: Inline text links and link-style buttons on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: accent-tab
tokens.usage: Icon and label colour of the selected tab-bar item.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Selected rows, selection bar, info callouts.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Running, connected, succeeded: status dots and their text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: In progress, needs attention, caution callouts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, stopped with error, destructive text links. Text/icons only; for buttons use danger-fill.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons (Uninstall, Empty trash, Reset) with ink text: 5.4:1.

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: Tab-bar count badge with white 11px bold text (4.8:1). Counts only, never a status colour.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (violet). Assign series in this order, never cycled; a 7th series folds into Other. Validated for colour-blind separation on surface-window and surface-row. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (coral). Assign series in this order, never cycled; a 7th series folds into Other. Validated for colour-blind separation on surface-window and surface-row. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (teal). Assign series in this order, never cycled; a 7th series folds into Other. Validated for colour-blind separation on surface-window and surface-row. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (amber). Assign series in this order, never cycled; a 7th series folds into Other. Validated for colour-blind separation on surface-window and surface-row. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (magenta). Assign series in this order, never cycled; a 7th series folds into Other. Validated for colour-blind separation on surface-window and surface-row. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 (blue). Assign series in this order, never cycled; a 7th series folds into Other. Validated for colour-blind separation on surface-window and surface-row. Marks only, never text.

accentSets.note: Settings › Appearance (D-023). Each set swaps only the accent family via data-accent on the root; violet is the default in color.tokens. Links and tab labels stay above 7:1, switch tracks above 3:1.

dock.note: Fixed Dock area tiles (D-054); they don't follow the accent.

tokens.name: dock-home
tokens.usage: Home: the hlabs app icon on Dusk.

tokens.name: dock-store
tokens.usage: App Store (blue).

tokens.name: dock-files
tokens.usage: Files (cyan).

tokens.name: dock-usage
tokens.usage: Usage (magenta).

tokens.name: dock-backups
tokens.usage: Backups (amber).

tokens.name: dock-settings
tokens.usage: Settings (grey).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your apps appear here once they're installed.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: List row titles, menu items, buttons (at 600).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels above list boxes; field labels.

spacing.note: 4px base. Windows pad 28–36px; list rows 12–14px by 16–18px; groups sit 8px under their label and 20px apart.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tab-bar inner padding, icon-to-label in tabs.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to its box; gap between small buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding; widget grid gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in a window.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog content gap on dense dialogs; app grid row gap.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Dialog and window padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Onboarding card padding; large empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Menu items, small file icons, code chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text fields, icon buttons, callouts.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List boxes (grouped rows), small app icons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards in windows, toasts, notification items.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: 76px app icons on Home (continuous-corner look).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Home widgets, menus' outer shell on large menus.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Windows, dialogs and onboarding cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, search pill, tab bar and its lens.

tokens.name: radius-dock
tokens.usage: The Dock shelf.

tokens.name: radius-dock-tile
tokens.usage: Dock tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-icon
tokens.usage: App icons: lift plus a top highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Windows and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-tabbar
tokens.usage: Liquid Glass tab bar (phone) and Dock shelf (desktop): bright top rim, faint bottom rim, soft lift.

blur.note: backdrop-filter strengths. The solid theme turns every blur off.

tokens.name: blur-bar
tokens.usage: Tab bar and bell (with saturate 190%).

tokens.name: blur-widget
tokens.usage: Home widgets (with saturate 150%).

tokens.name: blur-window
tokens.usage: Windows, dialogs, menus (with saturate 160%).

tokens.name: blur-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs and sheets, with scrim-strong: blurs everything under it (FactoryReset).

size.note: Fixed sizes the layouts depend on.

tokens.name: size-app-icon
tokens.usage: Home app icon; 56px in Store cards, 60px on phone.

tokens.name: size-tab-item
tokens.usage: Phone tab bar item width (54px tall). Desktop uses the Dock.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Minimum height of text fields and touch targets; buttons 34–48px on desktop.

tokens.name: size-window
tokens.usage: Desktop window width inside the 1440px frame.

tokens.name: size-dock-tile
tokens.usage: Dock tile (desktop navigation); 48px for pinned apps below 1280px wide.
